scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @yelang/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @yelang/web exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @yelang/web exec tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @yelang/server build && npm --prefix web run build && node scripts/prepare-sites-output.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm smoke
